svg.aria-label: TERRA — design-system board for an Earth-observation brand. A stylised Earth disc built only from the eight core tokens, eight token cards with hex and usage rules, a WCAG 2.1 contrast block with recomputed ratios, a 60-30-10 usage bar and a system-font type hierarchy.
